description: Defines data structures and functions related to UL-SCH (Uplink Shared Channel) information and configuration in 5G NR (New Radio) based on 3GPP TS38.212 specifications.

classes.name: ulsch_configuration
classes.description: Contains parameters necessary to configure UL-SCH transmission, including resource allocation, modulation, coding, and DM-RS settings.

classes.name: ulsch_information
classes.description: Holds derived UL-SCH parameters, including resource element counts, bits, and effective code rate calculation.

methods.name: get_ulsch_information
methods.description: Function to compute UL-SCH information based on a given configuration.
